items.title: Exercise special termination right (§ 57 TKG) due to price increase
items.quote: Das Kündigungsrecht besteht drei Monate ab Zugang dieser Mitteilung; der Vertrag endet frühestens zu dem Zeitpunkt, an dem der neue Preis wirksam wird.
items.computation: The letter is dated 15.04.2025 (Tuesday). It is a private company letter, not an authority notice, so no statutory delivery fiction (e.g. § 122 AO/§41 VwVfG) applies automatically. Lacking an explicit delivery date, I assume normal domestic postal transit of about 3 days, so Zugang (access) is taken as 18.04.2025 (Friday). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of Zugang is not counted when the period starts; under § 188 Abs. 2 BGB a period of months ends on the day of the last month bearing the same calendar number as the day of the triggering event (18.04.) - i.e. 18.07.2025. 18.07.2025 is a Friday and not a public holiday in NW, so no weekend/holiday shift under § 193 BGB is needed. The special termination must reach the provider by this date to be effective; the contract would then end no earlier than 01.06.2025, the date the new price takes effect.

items.quote: ab dem 01.06.2025 kostet Ihr Tarif „Netzwelt DSL 100“ 49,99 € statt bisher 44,99 € im Monat.
items.computation: The letter states the new price applies starting 01.06.2025; this date is given explicitly in the letter and requires no further calculation.

This is a private commercial notice (not an authority letter), so it carries no Einspruch/Widerspruch/Klage remedy instructions; the only legal recourse mentioned is the statutory special termination right under § 57 Abs. 1 TKG.
